hypotheses.name: Diffusion-distance sweep for regulatory edge discrimination
hypotheses.method: Screened scGPT domains (immune/lung/external_lung) across 3 seeds, source+target disjoint splits, layers {0,3,7,11}, and diffusion times {1,2,4,8}; compared best diffusion AUROC to max(Euclidean, geodesic) with per-row label-permutation nulls (n=180).
hypotheses.result_value: +0.0173 mean AUROC delta overall; 3/3 domains Fisher-significant
hypotheses.next_action: Run dual-axis disjoint + coexpression-matched null stress test to confirm robustness of the diffusion uplift.

hypotheses.name: Geometry x multi-prior biological anchoring interaction
hypotheses.method: Built edge-level table across all 3 domains and both disjoint splits using diffusion/geodesic/euclidean geometry scores plus DoRothEA support, GO co-membership, and TF-source priors; fit baseline vs interaction logistic models with degree-stratified prior permutations (n=180) and stratified bootstraps (n=180). TRRUST support was excluded from predictors due label leakage risk.
hypotheses.result_value: 0/6 rows with significant positive interaction; mean interaction=-0.1608; AUROC-delta combined Fisher p=0.0140
hypotheses.next_action: Re-run with independent STRING prior support and the same permutation/bootstrap protocol to test whether interaction weakness is prior-limited.

hypotheses.name: Unseeded Gromov-Wasserstein cross-model alignment
hypotheses.method: Aligned scGPT vs Geneformer matched-gene graphs (280 genes/domain) with unseeded GW (scaled costs, entropic solver with classic GW fallback), then evaluated map quality (top-1/mutual top-1), geometry transfer (distance Spearman, kNN Jaccard), and label transfer AUROC against random-correspondence nulls (n=180).
hypotheses.result_value: mean top-1=0.00119 (combined p=0.990), mean distance Spearman=0.8556 (combined p=2.33e-05), mean transfer AUROC=0.5186 (combined p=0.051)
hypotheses.next_action: Test CCA-seeded/one-to-one-regularized GW to improve correspondence recovery before treating this branch as promotable.
